title: Dedup State — DEC-038
description: DEC-038 Fluss-owns-large-state: dedup table entry count/bytes, update rate, Flink cache hit ratio/utilization, cleanup backlog, rehydration latency/failures. Bounded per-table gauges + per-reason counters. Source: fingerprint_dedup DDL 24, FlussFingerprintDedupStateStore + FingerprintDedupFunction cache.

panels.title: Fluss dedup-table entries — fingerprint_dedup count
panels.description: SELECT count(*) FROM metrics WHERE metric_name='fluss.dedup.entries' — per-table gauge (never per-key). Expected = first-seen rate × TTL horizon.

queries.query: SELECT max(value) as y, _timestamp as x FROM metrics WHERE metric_name='fluss.dedup.entries' GROUP BY x ORDER BY x

panels.title: Fluss dedup-table bytes — fingerprint_dedup storage
panels.description: Serialized bytes gauge for fingerprint_dedup. Per-table, not per-key.

queries.query: SELECT max(value) as y, _timestamp as x FROM metrics WHERE metric_name='fluss.dedup.bytes' GROUP BY x ORDER BY x

panels.title: Dedup update rate — durable writes/s
panels.description: Batched async writes/s to fingerprint_dedup. Per-table rate.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) as x, count(*) as y FROM metrics WHERE metric_name='fluss.dedup.updates' GROUP BY x ORDER BY x

panels.title: Flink dedup cache hit ratio — hot path absorbs
panels.description: Hit ratio = cache hits / total lookups. Sustained drop leaks to per-tick Fluss lookups. Bounded cache DEDUP_CACHE_MAX_ENTRIES/BYTES.

queries.query: SELECT avg(value) as y, _timestamp as x FROM metrics WHERE metric_name='flink.dedup.cache.hit_ratio' GROUP BY x ORDER BY x

panels.title: Expired-row cleanup — backlog and rate
panels.description: Rows past expiry_ms awaiting delete. Per-reason counter only.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) as x, count(*) as y FROM metrics WHERE metric_name='flink.dedup.cleanup.backlog' GROUP BY x ORDER BY x

panels.title: Rehydration — duration and failures on restart
panels.description: Rehydration latency and failures; failures keep job fail-closed SIG-STATE-002/003. State-compatibility preflight failures included.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) as x, count(*) as y FROM logs WHERE stream='trading_alerts' AND body LIKE '%rehydration%' GROUP BY x ORDER BY x LIMIT 100
